query = """
	SELECT 
	    s.RunID,
	    p.ProductCode,
	    r.RunStartDateTime AS StartTime,
	    r.RunStopDateTime AS EndTime,
	    (r.CurrentInfeed - r.StartInfeed) AS Infeed,
	    r.GoodCount AS Outfeed,
	    r.WasteCount AS Waste,
	    r.Performance,
	    r.GoodCount,
	    r.TotalCount
	FROM run r
	INNER JOIN schedule s 
	    ON r.ID = s.RunID
	INNER JOIN workorder w
	    ON s.WorkorderID = w.ID
	INNER JOIN productcode p
	    ON w.ProductCodeID = p.ID
	WHERE r.RunStartDateTime >= ?
	  AND r.RunStopDateTime <= ?;
	"""
	
	# Ejecutar la query con los parámetros
	results = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [self.params.startTime, self.params.endTime])
		
	return results

alerts.showAlert(state="warning", title="Guardar registro", message="Esta seguro de que desea guardar el registro de inicio de turno?", 
	btnTextPrimary="Si", btnTextSecondary="No", btnActionPrimary="saveStartRegister-PTARI")
	

	
	'''
	system.perspective.sendMessage("resetTable", payload={})
	
	listCustom = [
		"answers"
	]
	
	for path in listCustom:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer1").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer2").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer3").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
	
	
	listCustom = [
		"answers.seguridad",
		"answers.OperacionControl",
		"answers.EstadoMaquina"
	]
	for path in listCustom:
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))

	answerSeg = self.view.custom.answers.seguridad
	answerOp = self.view.custom.answers.OperacionControl
	answerEst = self.view.custom.answers.EstadoMaquina
	
	papoID = self.view.params.papoID
	user = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	workstationNodeID = self.view.params.workStationNodeID
	workstationID = self.view.params.workStationID
	nodeID = self.view.params.nodeID
	status = "En proceso"
	now = system.date.now()
	
	from java.lang import String
	
	query = """
		SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID=? AND PapoID=?
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	"""


	result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [workstationNodeID,papoID], "papo_db")
	
	regCode = result.getValueAt(0,0)
	
	if regCode==None:
		regCode=0

	def insert_answer(registerTypeID, answerJson, regCode):
		if not answerJson:
			return
		query = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,?)
		"""
		
		# ⚠️ Aseguramos que sea String plano
		data_answer_str = String(answerJson)
		
		params = [
			now,
			data_answer_str,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,
			workstationNodeID,
			nodeID,
			workstationID,
			regCode
		]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(query, params, "papo_db")
	
	# --- Insertar directo los tres JSON ---
	insert_answer(7, system.util.jsonEncode(answerSeg), regCode+1)  
	insert_answer(7, system.util.jsonEncode(answerOp), regCode+1)  
	insert_answer(7, system.util.jsonEncode(answerEst), regCode+1)  
	
	
	
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="refreshTable", 
	    payload={"estado": True,},
	    scope="session"
	)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="closeEmbeded", 
	    payload={"estado": False,},
	    scope="session"
	)
